item.name: Embed with empty body is rejected
Batch Ingestion
item.description: Batches of 5 or 10 files (.pdf, .docx, .doc) from RESUME_SOURCE_DIR (default ./resumes); scanned PDFs are OCR'd. Needs MongoDB and MISTRAL_API_KEY.

exec: pm.test('every supported file accounted for', () => pm.expect(d.ingested + d.duplicate + d.failed + d.pending).to.eql(d.supportedFiles));
pm.test('every failure has a reason', () => d.failures.forEach(f => pm.expect(f.reason).to.be.a('string')));
pm.test('counts add up', () => pm.expect(d.ingested + d.duplicate + d.failed).to.eql(d.selected));
pm.test('counts add up', () => pm.expect(d.ingested + d.duplicate + d.failed).to.eql(d.selected));

item.name: Phase 14-15 - Semantic Search
item.description: POST /v1/resume/search. Uses the Atlas index when it is ready (run npm run search:index), otherwise scores resumes in the app; data.mode says which.

exec: pm.test('mode is atlas or local', () => pm.expect(['atlas', 'local']).to.include(d.mode));
pm.test('sorted by score', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.score).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].score)));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("limit must be an integer between 1 and 50"));

item.name: Search with min > max experience is rejected

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("filters.minExperience must not be greater than filters.maxExperience"));

item.name: Phase 16 - Resume Management
item.description: List, get and delete stored resumes. Run 'List resumes' first; it saves the first id as resumeId.

item.name: List resumes by skill and location

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("limit must be an integer between 1 and 100"));

item.name: Retrieval Phase 1 - Readiness
item.description: GET /v1/search/readiness. Retrieval is ready only when resumes with matching mistral-embed 1024-d embeddings exist.

item.name: Retrieval Phase 3 - Query Embedding
item.description: POST /v1/embeddings. Embeds a search query with mistral-embed (1024 numbers).

item.name: Retrieval Phase 5 - BM25 Search
item.description: POST /v1/search/bm25. Atlas Search index resume_bm25 over rawText, skills, jobTitles, experienceSummary, role, company. No LLM call.

exec: pm.test('sorted by score', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.score).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].score)));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("topK must be an integer between 1 and 100"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("filters.minYearsExperience must be a non-negative number"));

item.name: Retrieval Phase 6 - Vector Search
item.description: POST /v1/search/vector. Embeds the query with mistral-embed, then Atlas Vector Search on resume_vector (cosine).

exec: pm.test('sorted by vectorScore', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.vectorScore).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].vectorScore)));
pm.test('sorted by vectorScore', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.vectorScore).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].vectorScore)));

item.name: Vector search with filter and exact re-score

exec: pm.test('sorted by vectorScore', () => d.results.forEach((r, i) => i && pm.expect(r.vectorScore).to.be.at.most(d.results[i - 1].vectorScore)));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("exactRescore must be true or false"));

item.name: Retrieval Phase 8 - Hybrid Search
item.description: POST /v1/search/hybrid. BM25 and vector search run in parallel; both lists are returned separately with timings. Scores are not merged.

exec: pm.test('some resumes appear in both lists', () => pm.expect(d.vector.some(r => bm25Ids.has(r.resumeId))).to.be.true);

item.name: Retrieval Phase 11 - LLM Re-Ranking
item.description: POST /v1/search/rerank. Groq orders the supplied candidates. Only ids from the input can come back; unknown ids are rejected.

request.description: Saves two real resume ids as resumeId1 / resumeId2 for the next requests.

exec: pm.test('ids are a subset of the input', () => d.results.forEach(r => pm.expect(input).to.include(r.resumeId)));
pm.test('scores 0-1 with a reason', () => d.results.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.relevanceScore).to.be.within(0, 1); pm.expect(r.reason).to.be.a('string'); }));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("candidates must be a non-empty array"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("candidates must not repeat a resumeId"));

item.name: Retrieval Phase 12 - Candidate Summary
item.description: POST /v1/search/summarize. Summary grounded only in the supplied snippet. Run 'Get candidate ids' in Phase 11 first.

item.name: maxTokens out of range is rejected

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("maxTokens must be an integer between 20 and 1000"));

item.name: Retrieval Phase 13-14 - Final Search
item.description: POST /v1/search. Full pipeline: query embedding, BM25 + vector in parallel, merge, deduplicate, top N, LLM re-rank, optional summaries.

exec: pm.test('summaries unless degraded', () => d.degraded || d.results.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.summary).to.be.a('string')));

item.name: Retrieval Phase 15 - Fallback Fields
item.description: Every /v1/search response reports degraded, warnings and, when used, vectorFallback / bm25Fallback. Failures cannot be forced from Postman; the fallback paths (re-rank, vector, BM25, summary, both failing) are covered by `npm test` (tests/unit/fallbacks.test.ts).

exec: pm.test('warnings only use documented codes', () => d.warnings.forEach(w => pm.expect(['LLM_RERANK_FAILED', 'SUMMARIZATION_FAILED']).to.include(w)));

item.name: Retrieval Phase 16 - Request IDs and Logging
item.description: Every response has an X-Request-Id header (yours is kept if you send one). The server logs one JSON line per request with componentTimings; check the npm run dev console.

item.name: Retrieval Phase 17 - Payload and Validation Limits
item.description: Limits: query 1000 chars, topK 100, rerankTopN 20, finalTopK <= rerankTopN, 50 re-rank candidates, snippet 2000 chars, maxTokens 20-1000, JSON body 100kb (413 above).

exec: pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Search query must be at most 1000 characters"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("topK must be an integer between 1 and 100"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("options.finalTopK must not be greater than options.rerankTopN"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("options.rerankTopN must be an integer between 1 and 20"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("filters.minYearsExperience must be a non-negative number"));
pm.test('message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Request body is not valid JSON"));

item.name: Retrieval Phase 18 - Automated Tests
item.description:
Run in a terminal, not Postman:
- `npm test` - 35 unit tests: deduplication, candidate mapping, filter validation, BM25/vector normalization, LLM output validation, Groq key fallback, fallback ordering.
- `npm run test:integration` - 10 tests against the real API, MongoDB, Mistral and Groq for every retrieval endpoint, including the end-to-end search.
